name: Mannfred von Carstein
canonNotes: The most cunning and treacherous of the Vampire Counts of Sylvania, a master of necromancy who rose by betraying his own sire, Vlad.
Seeks absolute dominion and above all the power of Nagash for himself.
voiceNotes: Silky, arrogant and manipulative; courtesy that barely hides contempt.
Always scheming several moves ahead; never admits weakness.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
